sentences: Traders moved $707 million through Polymarket in the week of 2026-10-26, across 16.6 million individual trades. Algorithmic wallets accounted for 53% of weekly counterparty events (both maker and taker sides counted); everyone else split the remaining 47%.
The most-traded market was "Will Benjamin Netanyahu be the next Prime Minister of Israel?", pulling in $11 million of volume. Politics dominated the week's attention.
Both sides made money this week. Bots collected $173K (+110 bps); retail collected $32K (+261 bps).
